  "scores": {
    "architecture": 9,
    "behavior": 8,
    "authority_security": 7,
    "validation": 8,
    "overall": 8
  },
  "required_fixes": [
    "R1 — Fail closed when credential checking cannot parse a draft. gateway_local.rs:129-148 treats a JSON parse failure as containing no credentials. The editor autosaves arbitrary text after a pause (runtime-changes.tsx:210-225), save_gateway_draft stores it unchanged, and gateway_local.rs:217-223 serializes it into an unencrypted owner-only file. Thus an incomplete draft such as {\"key\":\"CANARY-SECRET\", is accepted and persisted even though the equivalent valid JSON is refused. It is also returned in local-work snapshots. Acceptance: credential-bearing incomplete/malformed text must not enter durable local work or restored snapshots; retain safe local editing without assuming unparsable text is nonsecret. Cover complete, truncated, nested and escaped credential fields with synthetic canaries, including a restart, and preserve the existing size bounds.",
    "R2 — Retire Gateway local books, load leases and pending writes when reset is admitted. authority.rs:2676-2688 clears the existing report/library/workbench stores but leaves gateway_local and gateway_local_writes intact. gateway_local_write:338-353 refuses only while storage is Resetting; after settle_reset restores Ready, the old tenant/generation remains eligible even though that tenant was removed. A StoreGatewayLocal task delayed until after reset releases report_writer can therefore recreate the purged file from its retained book. A pre-reset load can also settle against its still-valid lease and schedule a later write. Acceptance: use the production reset path with held writers and delayed loads, then release stale work after reset completion; no Gateway file or cached draft/record may reappear. Fence old generations permanently, and preserve tenant-deletion protection and unrelated namespaces.",
    "R3 — Preserve recovery accounting across tenant and credential retirement without preserving authority. change_domain.rs:982-984 removes every ChangeRecord outside the active ContextRef before :994-1026 can consume its Apply result and call gateway_local_settled. Consequently, switching tenant or replacing a credential while a dispatched Gateway write/provisioning is awaiting its reply drops LocalOrigin and the eventual uncertain outcome. Returning to that tenant or restarting has no recovery record for an operation the service may have performed. The new restart test waits for settlement before restarting and misses this interval. Acceptance: hold a dispatched write or provisioning step, change tenant and separately replace the credential, then let cancellation/settlement complete; retain a sanitized historical record under the originating tenant/workspace across offline restart. Withdraw old reviews/replies/keys from the active context, never replay automatically, and suppress historical writes after tenant deletion or reset."
  ],
  "blockers": [],
  "evidence_gaps": [
    "G2 — The supplied local-work regressions and native restart flow do not cover malformed credential drafts, delayed local work crossing reset, or an applying change crossing tenant/credential retirement. Add causal production-interface regressions for R1–R3 and refresh the source-bound evidence. Attempt-01 G1's missing advertised-operation wire cases are supplied in this attempt."
  ],
  "optional_suggestions": [],
  "limitations": [
    "All four supplied fingerprints recompute exactly. Verified 561 source-inventory entries, 295 referenced hashes, command log/artifact hashes and the direct C16 predecessor packet/verdict/raw-output hashes. C16's failed review was owner-accepted under D034; that remains distinct from a passing review and does not remove the P05 re-review requirement.",
    "Attempt-01 R1–R5 have targeted source fixes and regressions: workspace retirement before dispatch, allow_all_models readback, truthful reconciliation/cleanup summaries, workspace identification under a reused IAM scope, and preservation of answered writes/one-time keys when readback stops. R6 now has offline draft/recovery persistence and explicit retry without replay, with the lifecycle/privacy defects listed above.",
    "Recorded checks pass: 366 desktop tests, 166 core library tests, 19 Gateway change integration tests, and the scoped Runtime/DLP/Gateway-read/IPC regressions. The literal operation matrix exercises the previously missing writes through the Core interface with success, rejection and lost-reply assertions. All 48 mutation probes report named guard failures; their seven source hashes match, and four baseline targets passed three times each.",
    "The 12 C17 native checks report pass against fixture executable 37fe0cba77079c78fe9e7a247c9baafe1786ca1281d054be6d671a6dc7ac2dce. Inspected the native driver, observations and Accessibility evidence, including offline draft editing and reconnect without writes. Native acceptance was not independently rerun; spoken VoiceOver output is not recorded.",
    "The new findings are established by source and test inspection; the reset race is a permitted scheduling interleaving, not a newly executed endpoint reproduction. No builds, application tests or product endpoints were run for this review. Gateway service evidence uses synthetic fixtures; live qualification remains C25 and signed installed-package qualification C26.",
    "No application source was changed or credentials accessed. Only the designated verdict artifact was written."
  ],
